common.retry_policy: as shipped: up to 3 attempts on 408, 429 and 5xx with backoff for a first ask; a re-ask is sent once; a request set aside is asked again at most 2 more times, each at least 300 s after its previous answer or attempt; the Coupons page asked again while its list has not loaded, at most 4 answers for the run, 60 s apart (1.10.0rc6, OR-04); each submission reserved at its worst case
stop_conditions: the operator's slice target (SIGTERM: a resumable stop) before the stage's submission ceiling
the stage's submission ceiling (the collector's own ceiling and the account-wide gate)
store or fulfillment not verified on a page (STORE_NOT_VERIFIED)
ABNORMAL_RESULT, SITE_REFUSAL or three pages in a row not read (PROVIDER_ERROR; the collector resumes itself up to 3 times, 60 s later)
a ledger refusal, or more than 2 outcomes left unknown

by the operator (watch_stage.sh, counted from the slice's own start): 10 re-asks answered in the slice and none recovered its request; or 16 or more answers to a page 2 or later in the slice of which 25% or more repeat an earlier page (the share is read at the watcher's start from repeat_stop_pct, set to 25 for R7: on 2026-11-16 a quarter of such answers repeated by 15Z, and every re-ask exhausted that day was at 15-23Z; R6a's watcher had no repeat rule); either stops the stage resumably and it is reported as it stands
common.approval: Hamza's brief of 16 November 2026 (closeout after 1.10.0rc5): USD 5 of free credit authorized for Mariano's on the Oxylabs Web API credential he supplied, on his own Azure VM, accounted in the campaign oxylabs-marianos-20261116 (cap 5.00, headroom 0.10, Mariano's envelope 4.90); the client's VM, the client's billing, Oxylabs Classic and other providers stay outside it; no top-up or paid overage

R6a.objective: one logical full-scope run R6 of the candidate 1.10.0rc6 (every CSV row 0-27 as configured; not a pilot: --rows-first only orders the plan, reading rows 22, 27, 23 to 26 and 15 first, and --term-upc names the four product pages of the review; neither narrows the scope), two lanes, read in slices, each one ledger stage of the new credential's campaign oxylabs-marianos-20261116 whose ceiling is also set in the collector (set-ceiling). Operator check during it: a second start for the store is refused (exit 9) before any request (a gate refusing every submission, no lease).
R6a.passes_when: the slice ends with the operator's SIGTERM at 150 reservations (exit 75, the run interrupted and resumable); every page verified for 53100502 PICKUP; at most 2 unknown outcomes; the second start exits 9 with no ledger row
